# PortAudio public headers

Unmodified `portaudio.h` and `pa_asio.h` from PortAudio v19.7.0, commit `147dd722548358763a8b649b3e4b41dfffbcfbb6`:
https://github.com/PortAudio/portaudio/tree/147dd722548358763a8b649b3e4b41dfffbcfbb6/include

Copyright and MIT-style licensing notices are retained inside each header. The production library is built from an external PortAudio source directory with ASIO enabled; test doubles never ship with the application. Steinberg ASIO SDK is an external build dependency, not included in this repository.
